newsitem.title: UK: GWB to float Aquarius subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: GWB to float Aquarius subsidiary.

text.p: Gartland Whalley and Barker Plc (GWB) said on Monday it plans to seek a full market listing for its Aquarius subsidiary.

GWB, which floated on AIM in August, acquires, develops and floats industrial businesses. Aquarius designs and manufactures home improvement products and was put together by the company in 1994 and 1995.
"The skills, experience and contacts of the GWB management have enabled us to build up and float, successfully, three groups to date," said chairman Tony Gartland.
"The planned flotation... is part of this on-going strategy and emphasises our wish to obtain above-average returns on our investments."
